scripts.ios:format: swift format format --in-place --recursive Reader ReaderCore/Package.swift ReaderCore/Sources ReaderCore/Tests
scripts.ios:lint: swift format lint --strict --recursive Reader ReaderCore/Package.swift ReaderCore/Sources ReaderCore/Tests
scripts.ios:build: bun run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project InsuranceReader.xcodeproj -scheme InsuranceReader -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:check-device: bun run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project InsuranceReader.xcodeproj -scheme InsuranceReader -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build-device CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:launch: bun run ios:build && xcrun simctl bootstatus 'iPhone 17 Pro' -b && xcrun simctl install 'iPhone 17 Pro' .build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/InsuranceReader.app && xcrun simctl launch 'iPhone 17 Pro' org.openinsurance.reader.demo
